title: aisync 演示：两个 AI 同时要改一个文件

steps.cmd: aisync claim -a claude-code -p checkout-api -f app/api/refunds.py -m "加上退款原因"
aisync claim -a codex -p checkout-api -f app/api/refunds.py -m "重命名退款字段"
aisync log -a codex -p checkout-api -k blocked -m "等 claude-code 改完 app/api/refunds.py"
aisync claim -a codex -p checkout-api -f app/api/refunds.py -m "重命名退款字段"
